snippet.title: Astral Ascent - New Hero DLC - Yamat the Breach Traveler
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam ✧ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073420/Astral_Ascent__Yamat_the_Breach_Traveler/

Yamat the Breach Traveler is the first DLC coming out for Astral Ascent.

Play as a new hero with her own weapons, spells and dialogs fully voiced in english and japanese!
